overview: Continental programme that recruits young African professionals and deploys them for 12 months of volunteer service in another African Union Member State. The 2026 call (13th cohort) ran from 26 March to 26 April 2026; no call was open on 26 October 2026.

Last call (13th cohort, AU press release of 26 March 2026): 'Applications are opened for qualified young Africans across the continent and the Diaspora from 26 March to 26 April 2026'; 'All applications must be submitted by April 26, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. EAT.'
